name: Tm Stacked Variance
pitch: See what each scenario is made of, and exactly where the total moved.
question: Why did the total change between scenarios?
useWhen: Compare scenario totals across plans or periods.

hero.alt: Six scenarios as stacked columns with totals and green or red variance callouts between neighbors.
hero.caption: Six scenarios, their mix, and every change in between.

screenshots.alt: Three scenarios joined by stepped bridges with signed variance callouts.
screenshots.caption: Stepped bridges link each total to the next.

screenshots.alt: Three scenarios joined by sloped bridges with signed variance callouts.
screenshots.caption: Sloped bridges show the direction of each change.

questions: Which segment drove the gap to plan?
How does the mix differ between scenarios?
Is the change good or bad news?
audience: Finance, planning and BI teams comparing plans, forecasts and alternatives.

featureStrips.heading: Totals side by side
featureStrips.text: Every scenario is a stack with its net total on top, so the size of each plan is clear at once.

featureStrips.heading: Variance between scenarios
featureStrips.text: Bridges and callouts show the signed change and percentage, green for better and red for worse.

featureStrips.heading: Gains and losses in one stack
featureStrips.text: Negative segments draw below the line, and the total is the net sum.

featureStrips.heading: Compare in the order you need
featureStrips.text: Compare left to right, right to left, or outwards from a base scenario.

featureStrips.heading: Many segments stay readable
featureStrips.text: Smaller segments group into Others, so eight product lines and more stay easy to read.

featureStrips.heading: Shares inside each scenario
featureStrips.text: Turn on percentage labels to see how each segment's share moves between scenarios.

features: See every scenario as a stack with its net total on top.
Read signed variance and percentage between scenarios in a callout.
Gains and losses stack on both sides of the zero line.
Compare left to right, right to left, or outwards from a base scenario.
Group smaller segments into Others to keep many segments readable.
Click a segment to filter the rest of the sheet.
